PREFIX brick: <http://brick.exemplar.network/>
PREFIX ref: <http://reference.exemplar.network/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?label ?point ?tsid ?class WHERE {
  ?point rdfs:label ?label .
  FILTER(?label IN ("CHWPump02","Chiller02","SupplyFan_AHU01"))
  ?point ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
  ?point a ?class .
}
